content: Definition of legislative freeze frame for WWWH-OBD The legislative WWH-OBD freeze frame is identified by the reference DiagnosticTrou- bleCodeProps . freezeFrame where attribute recordNumber is set to the value 0. Optionally, the existence of a reference in the role DiagnosticTroubleCodeProps . extendedDataRecord with attribute recordNumber set to the value 90 is sup- ported.
